claims.text: Machine Learning Potentials can accurately predict the melting temperature of high-melting refractory materials.
Machine Learning Potentials can accurately predict the entropy of fusion of high-melting refractory materials.
Machine Learning Potentials can accurately predict the enthalpy of fusion of high-melting refractory materials.
Machine Learning Potentials can accurately predict the volume change at the melting point of high-melting refractory materials.
Machine Learning Potentials significantly reduce computational cost relative to the ab initio DFT free-energy approach.
Machine Learning Potentials represent potential-energy surfaces fitted using machine-learning algorithms.
Using Machine Learning Potentials can reduce computational cost by up to three orders of magnitude.
The computational-cost reduction from Machine Learning Potentials makes high-throughput melting-property calculations feasible.
The applicability and accuracy of Machine Learning Potentials depend on training-dataset size, model architecture, and simulation time step.
The accuracy of Machine Learning Potentials may depend on material-specific properties and simulation conditions.
